newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Petron climbs 4.23 pct in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Petron climbs 4.23 pct in late trade.

text.p: Oil refiner Petron Corp gained 30 centavos, or 4.23 percent, to 7.40 pesos in late trade on Thursday joining the bandwagon of buying in index heavyweight issues ahead of the release later in the day of first quarter GNP figures, traders said.

"Petron is one of the economically sensitive stocks which would be affected by the first quarter GNP figure. Given the government's upbeat comments on the GNP figure, we see sentiment improving for this issue," said Manuel Goseco, analyst at Dharmala Securities.
Petron was the fourth most actively traded issue joining several blue chip heavy gainers Meralco B, Philippine National Bank, and Ayala Land Inc.
"There seems to be a repositioning on the old reliables," said Helen Alvarez, research director at All Asia Securities.
Socio-Economic Planning Secretary Cielito Habito had said that first quarter GNP would be about the same as last year's 6.6 percent and growth rates in the succeeding quarters would even be stronger.
The figures will be announced later on Thursday.
